Question 1
?

The point (1,2) is stretched with invariant y-axis and stretch factor −3, and then stretched with invariant x-axis and stretch factor 2. What is the resulting point?

a
(−3,4)
b
(−2,4)
c
(2,−6)
d
(3,4)
e
(1,−12)
